name: report-button
description: A drop-in "Report a problem" button: the user annotates a screenshot of what they see, and it lands as a GitHub issue.
author: Caleb Cauthon

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:types
scripts.build:client: esbuild src/client/browser.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/report-button.js && esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2020 --packages=external --outfile=dist/report-button.esm.js && cp demo/demo.html dist/demo.html
